# Injuries Cause Memory Loss
Being incapacitated, entering a critical state, and dying should result in a loss of memories for your character. This should be proportionate to the cause of the injury, as well as any surrounding context.
## Injury And Intrigue [bold]Memory loss should result in mysteries[/bold]. Any instance of someone being incapacitated or dying is a cause for concern, and should be treated with gravitas. Try to forget just enough of what happened to allow people to worry.
If you were killed or crit by a freak accident or a hostile creature from the vents, you are not obligated to forget more than you absolutely need to in order to not immediately piece together the cause of your death. As a general rule of thumb, you may remember anything unrelated to your injuries but should forget most of the direct lead-up.
An edge case exception is made for IPCs that die after running out of battery, who do not need to forget anything once rebooted.
## Incapacitation If you were knocked into a critical state, your recollection of events and your general awareness should be hazy. You are able to talk and use your radio while incapacitated or critical. [bold]You may not report an attacker this way[/bold]. You may however call for help, especially if you are stranded off-station or if what is endangering you is not another player.
Being in a critical state is no joke. You should behave as though you're on death's doorstep while critical and even potentially for a short period after recovering, because you are. You should not act as though calm and rational while critical unless your intent is to bleed out in a friend's arms.
## Death If you were killed by a player, you may note the injuries when you wake up based on the state of your body and clothes, but you may not remember who killed you. You must not recognize them without being informed IC, and should use reasonable escalation if considering revenge. If you took your own life, you should not remember the act or its lead-up, and you must not repeat the act again that round.
